explanation: Uruguay and Argentina could not agree, so Argentina's ball was used before half-time and Uruguay's after. Argentina led 2-1 at the break; Uruguay won 4-2.

claims.text: In the 1930 World Cup final the teams could not agree on a ball, so Argentina's ball was used in the first half and Uruguay's in the second.
Argentina led the 1930 final 2-1 at half-time, and Uruguay won 4-2.
